market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from US-Iran strikes, rate-hike repricing post-Warsh, and PG&E/Edison credit shock. Expect volatility in energy, utilities, and rate-sensitive sectors. Oil elevated; equities under pressure. Dollar weakening. Crypto and gold dip on rate fears. 1-3 month outlook: choppy, risk-off bias with energy as relative outperformer.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains intact with broadening beyond Mag 7. Sovereign debt sustainability (US $40T, France, Colombia) is the dominant 6-12 month macro risk. G20 growth agenda and Bessent's fiscal signals will shape policy. Apple transition and insurance M&A create sector-specific opportunities. Commodity inflation (crops, oil) pressures consumer margins. Tokenized securities and AI infrastructure are structural growth themes.
